formulas.formula: Know what every sale really earns after fees, costs and shipping.
Setup: shop name, year, your hourly rate and Etsy's fees (US rates are filled in).
Products: each item with its price and what it costs you. See profit per sale and a target price.
Orders: log each sale. Leave Price blank to use the Products price. Tick Offsite ad if it came from one.
Expenses: everything else the shop costs (supplies in bulk, ads, tools).
Monthly, Product Stats and Dashboard update themselves. Price Calculator helps price new items.
$0.20 listing + 6.5% transaction + 3% and $0.25 payment processing, on the item price plus shipping.
15% of the order (12% for big shops). Only when the sale came from an offsite ad.
Setup can count your time as a cost, so profit means after paying yourself.
Etsy collects and pays it for you, so leave it out of everything here.
Red = losing money or a typo.

Charged again each time it sells.
15, or 12 for shops over $10k a year.
Profit per sale = one item, one order, no offsite ad. Cost per item includes your time if Setup says so.
One row per order. Blank Qty = 1. Blank Price = the price on the Products tab.
Shop costs that aren't tied to one order: bulk supplies, ads, tools, subscriptions.
